It's generally recommended to seek medical attention if you've been stung by a bee, especially if you experience any of the following symptoms: - Difficulty breathing - Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat - Dizziness or fainting - Abdominal cramps - Nausea or vomiting In this scenario, it's better to prioritize your health and safety by stopping to assess the situation and potentially seeking medical attention.
